text:
sam (release): kicking off staggered rollout for feature-flag `user_abide_v2`. Stage 1 -> 5% of prod traffic (canary group A). Targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 300ms, error rate < 0.1%. Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/rollouts/user_abide_v2

anya: noted. I pushed the runtime hotfix to handle new cache keys. I'll watch latency.

deploy-bot: Deploy started — canary group A (5%) — commit abc123 — view: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/abc123 :rocket:

kai (sre): seeing a small bump in outbound connections on gw-07, ~+8% now. Not alarming but watching. If p95 crosses 320ms I'll flag.

grace (qa): running smoke suite against canary A — all critical flows green. minor warning in reranker test (flaky), logs attached.

jess (product): tagging for spike watch. Any customer-facing config I should notify? :eyes:

miguel (devex): quick heads-up — infra migration scheduled in 10m for metrics pipeline; might delay metric rollup by ~2-3m. If you need real-time alerts, hold on.

sam (release): thanks @miguel — pause rollout for 15m. will re-evaluate after migration completes.

deploy-bot: Deploy paused by sam (release).

anya: ack. I'll stop any further config toggles. Will post when ready to resume.

kai (sre): I'll keep alerts muted for the migration window but will run manual checks. ping me if anything >0.2% errors.

sam (release): plan: resume at +20m, increase to 25% then 50% if metrics stable. Will post final resume command. thx everyone.

jess (product): noted. I'll stand by to send customer comms if we hit 50% without issues.

grace (qa): will re-run smoke after resume.

sam (release): update: migration finished, metrics back. resuming in 5m. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary resumed — group A remains 5% — resume by sam (release) at 1769004389.

anya: initial p95 280ms, p50 45ms, errors 0.02% — looks good.

kai (sre): no new spikes, rolling to 25% now ok from infra side.

sam (release): increasing to 25%... will watch for 10m, then proceed to 50% if green.

[end]
